title: Bless TV Anime Reveals Main Cast, January 2027 Debut
content: The Aniplex One Focus livestream event on Saturday revealed the main cast, January 2027 debut, and teaser visual for the television anime of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga. The anime will star Tomohiro Ōno as Aia Udagawa and Chiyuki Miura as Jun Sumisaki.
author: ANN

title: 'Koiseyo Mayakashi Tenshi-domo' Unveils Main Cast, Additional Staff, Promo
content: The Aniplex One Focus 2026 event unveiled the main cast, additional staff, and a cast announcement promotional video for the television anime adaptation of Coco Uzuki 's Koiseyo Mayakashi Tenshi-domo ( Fall in Love, You False Angels ) manga on Saturday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Vertex Force' Reveals Additional Cast, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content: The Aniplex One Focus 2026 event revealed additional cast, theme songs, a key visual (pictured), and the second promotional video for the Vertex Force original television anime on Friday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on Tokyo MX, BS11, Gunma TV, and Tochigi TV at 11:30 p.m. on October 3.
